scope: 以下流程与样例由本站设计；样例均为虚构教学输入，参考文件不是产品运行记录。
Workflows and samples are designed for this site. Inputs are fictional teaching material; references are not product execution records.
change: rows.filter(passed !== false) over all rows -> only boolean-judged rows enter the numerator and the denominator

denominator_rule.unjudged: excluded from the denominator and reported as a separate count
denominator_rule.error_or_timeout: excluded, with a reason code recorded per row

report_counts_with: every percentage is paired with its graded and unjudged counts
limit: Case one does not distinguish the two functions. Regression thresholds, judge-model bias and dataset leakage checks are outside this exercise.
rollback: Restore score-bug.mjs or reverse the two-line scoring change.
conclusion: A metric number without a denominator rule is not an evaluation result.
